HomePage.title: Find a GP practice, dentist or pharmacy in the UK
HomePage.hook: Every NHS GP practice, dental practice and pharmacy in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland already has a page.

free.description: Free for practices and patients, with no subscription and no commission.

registry.heading: Built from NHS open data
registry.intro: Each page starts from the lists the NHS publishes as open data in each nation, under the Open Government Licence: NHS England's Organisation Data Service for England and Wales, Public Health Scotland, and the Business Services Organisation in Northern Ireland. Practices are listed, never individual clinicians. Nobody pays to be listed, and nobody is left out.

errors.INVALID_RPPS: This code is not valid: it is the practice's ODS code (for example A81001), or the end of the address of its page, or the whole address.

start.lead: A claim targets one practice page, never a name.
start.contestBody: If it is your practice's (for instance you lost access to your account), you can still claim it: an administrator reviews your document and decides. Recovering an account always goes through a new verification.
start.notFound: No public page has this code yet.
start.rppsLabel: ODS code or address of the page
start.rppsHint: Your practice's ODS code (for example A81001), or the address of its page, for example apercura.org/gb/practice/the-example-surgery-a81001.
start.contactLink: No document to hand? Contact us

document.summary: A document that shows you act for the practice: an NHS contract or a letter from the commissioner (ICB, health board or BSO) naming the practice, or a professional registration (GMC, GDC, GPhC) with a letter on the practice's letterhead. A member of our team reviews it, usually within 48 hours.
document.lead: Send a document that shows you act for the practice: an NHS contract or a letter from its commissioner naming the practice, or your professional registration with a letter on the practice's letterhead. It is encrypted before it is stored, and deleted 30 days after the decision.

kind.cps_card: Professional registration (GMC, GDC or GPhC) with a letter on the practice's letterhead
kind.ordre_attestation: NHS contract or letter from the commissioner naming the practice

status.contestReview: This page already had a verified owner: an administrator decides on your document.
status.reviewBody: A member of our team reviews your document and writes to you by email.
status.contestBody: An administrator will decide on your document.

Gdpr.rppsHint: The practice's ODS code (for example A81001), the end of the address of the page, or the whole address.

report.doneBody: We check it. Facts from the NHS lists are corrected at the source, by the practice's commissioner or the NHS organisation that publishes the list; we tell you if you left an address.

removal.doneBody: It is no longer shown, indexed or listed. We check the request and answer by email within one month at most. Once it is confirmed, the page is deleted for good and does not come back with the NHS lists' updates.
removal.privacy: A deleted page does not come back with the next import of the NHS lists.
removal.claimedBody: Only its holder can remove it, from the page editor of their space: the page then disappears at once and does not come back with the NHS lists' updates.

contact.lead: You cannot claim your practice's page with a document? Leave us your details: a member of the Apercura team gets back to you to check that you act for the practice and help you.
contact.claimFirst: With a document that shows you act for the practice, claiming is quicker:

body: We have received your claim and its documents. A member of the Apercura team reviews them and writes to you by email.
We review claims within 48 hours on working days.
We could not verify your claim. Reason given by the reviewer: {reason}
You can open a new claim from your space, with a legible document that shows you act for the practice.
The page is hidden from now on: it is no longer shown, indexed or listed.
We check the request and answer within one month at most. Once it is confirmed, the page is deleted; a deleted page does not come back with the next import of the NHS lists.
The page you asked us to remove has been deleted from Apercura. It will not come back with the next import of the NHS lists.

check.lead: Your page starts from the NHS open data of your nation. Check the practice's name, type and addresses.
check.registryNote: Something wrong? The lasting fix is made with your commissioner or the NHS organisation that publishes the list; the page follows at the next weekly import. You can hide an address or add one in the page editor.
